evidence.quote: Persons whose income is at or up to 200% of the guidelines will be considered for complete forgiveness of their outstanding bill.

tiers.description: Table: 210% FPG gets 90% discount (table lists in 10% steps; bands approximate)

evidence.quote: Persons whose income is greater than 200% of the guidelines, but not more than 400% of the guidelines, shall be eligible for Community Care on a reduced basis.

residency.area: Primary and secondary service areas for Community Care; non-residents without insurance get only a self-pay discount

evidence.quote: Community Care write-offs are available to eligible persons residing in our primary and secondary service areas requiring medically necessary treatment, but who are unable to pay for these services.
Financial Assistance applications will be accepted by agency if (a) within 240 days from date of first post- discharged bill or (b) if later, 30 days from the date of ECA notification.

presumptive_eligibility: Electronic screening may grant presumptive eligibility for groups such as incarcerated, homeless, Medicaid eligible but not on the date of service, or deceased with no estate.
how_to_apply: Complete the signed Financial Questionnaire (Attachment 2) returned by mail or online at www.forthealthcare.com; an appointment with the Patient Financial Advocate is available.
warnings: Policy refers to Community Services Administration poverty guidelines and FPL/FPG interchangeably.
Uninsured self-pay patients get an automatic 68% self-pay discount (AGB) separate from Community Care.
Discount tiers come from the table, which lists 10% steps; boundaries between table rows are inferred and the policy does not state them.
Patients above 200% FPL must apply for Medicaid or Marketplace coverage before the application is processed.
Patients with HSA, HRA or FSA are expected to use those funds first.
Balances older than 240 days from date of service sent to collections are not eligible.
Catastrophic adjustment may apply for expenses exceeding income.
Services not covered include cosmetic, bariatric, fertility, and retail services.
Policy text says application is accepted 240 days from first post-discharge bill or, if later, 30 days after ECA notification.
Asset test is not stated, so the value is null.
